policy.name: llm
policy.description: Content-aware SLM ABR policy (greedy-teacher). NOTE: encoded segments are 2.0 s but the simulated player buffered in 3.3 s units; sim times are copied verbatim (not rescaled).

notes: SINGLE-UE bundle: only the UE that received the whole video is included (re-indexed ue=0); the feeder was shared by simulated_num_ues UEs during the run. STALLS/rebuffer in player_events.jsonl + summary.json are computed from the REAL ns-3 sim.log MPEG player (stall_start/stall_end with source:'sim.log'; a never-resumed freeze is a terminal:true stall to session end), NOT from decisions.jsonl. summary.ue.completed says whether the stream played to the end. segments/samples come from decisions.jsonl. sim_log_decision_agreement<1.0 means the attached sim.log is a sibling re-execution of this cell. Encoded segments are 2.0 s but the player buffered in 3.3 s units; sim times verbatim. sim_stop_time_s is this UE's session end.
